name: DeepSeek Harness
postCreateCommand: npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest && echo '✅ dsh 已安装'
postAttachCommand: bash -lc 'if ! curl -s -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8080/; then nohup dsh --profile web --no-open --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080 > /tmp/dsh.log 2>&1 & sleep 6; fi; cat /tmp/dsh.log | tail -20'
